title: Zingiber officinale tincture for medicinal use
intro: Zingiber officinale tincture is a concentrated liquid extract made from the dried rhizomes of the ginger plant. It is commonly used in herbalism to support digestion, reduce nausea, and alleviate inflammation. The tincture is typically prepared by soaking fresh or dried ginger in alcohol to extract its active compounds. It can be taken orally in small doses to relieve symptoms such as motion sickness or digestive discomfort. This preparation is valued for its warming properties and its ability to promote circulation and ease muscle pain.
